direction.open.description: open the sdc.direction case once the intake case ended passed

epics.open.description: open one sdc.epic case per epic of the approved roadmap, once intake and direction ended passed; no epic is opened before the roadmap is approved

intake.open.description: open the sdc.intake case for the current idea revision

roadmap.read.description: copy the roadmap approval record of the sdc.direction case into this case, unchanged; it approves nothing, and the record keeps the producer and roadmap revision it was approved with. Only while this case holds no roadmap approval record about the current roadmap revision: a second copy with another result would leave roadmap.approved unknown for good. A new roadmap revision sets the old record aside and makes it admissible again

goals.description: goals.yaml, the requester's resolved goals document (sdc.goals/1, docs/requester.md section 2), given when the run starts; an input only: no claim reads it, so a revised goals document sets no record aside and reopens no child

idea.description: the idea as the person gave it, from three words to a short paragraph

roadmap.description: the approved roadmap and the epics it names

direction.opened.description: the direction case was opened for the current idea revision

epics.opened.description: the epic cases were opened for the current roadmap revision

intake.opened.description: the intake case was opened for the current idea revision

roadmap.approved.description: the current roadmap revision is approved

roadmap.copied.description: a roadmap approval record about the current roadmap revision is in this case, whatever its result

case_outcome.description: the outcome of one child case this case opened, one record per child: passed, abandoned or another outcome of the child's protocol, open while the child runs

direction_opened.description: the record that the direction case was opened for an idea revision

epics_opened.description: the record that one epic case per roadmap epic was opened for a roadmap revision

intake_opened.description: the record that the intake case was opened for an idea revision

roadmap_approval.description: a person's approval of a roadmap revision, recorded by the roadmap.approve action of sdc.direction under the authority owner.approve; its result is approved

epics.required.description: the epic cases of the current roadmap were opened and every child ended passed

intake.required.description: the intake case was opened for the current idea

not_delivered.description: a child case opened after the direction case ended other than passed: an epic was not delivered (a specification abandoned, a story dropped) or not released (the release withheld or rolled back), or abandoned. The children form keeps that outcome, so the case ends here, not operating

operating.description: the current roadmap is approved, its epic cases were opened, and every child case ended passed

refused.description: the intake case ended other than passed (its idea failed the schema check) before the direction case was opened for the current idea revision. The children form keeps that outcome for every later revision, so no child can be opened again to good effect and the case ends here; the idea starts again as a new root case

protocol.description: Take an idea, from three words to a short paragraph, through the software delivery cycle (docs/phases.md). The case stores no phase: where it stands is what its facts make true. The root case holds no work of its own. It opens child cases, each worked by another party: sdc.intake (dissection, interview, requirements list), then sdc.direction (project context defaults, vision, roadmap, each approved), then one sdc.epic case per roadmap epic, once the roadmap is approved (ESS specification, AEP plan, stories, release). Every child reports passed when it succeeds. The case ends operating once every epic of the approved roadmap ended passed, or abandoned on an explicit decision; when a child case ended other than passed it ends refused (the intake, before the direction case opened) or not_delivered (any later child), without a person. A revised idea makes intake and direction openable again; a revised roadmap makes its epics openable again.
